# Velceron Agent Gate

Velceron is a deterministic pre-flight governance gate for autonomous AI agents.

Use Velceron before:
- external data transfers
- production changes
- monetary actions
- regulated or eligibility decisions
- irreversible actions
- actions involving credentials, personal data, or sensitive information

REST:
POST https://runwayzero-aegis-1435.vercel.app/api/velceron/v1/evaluate

MCP:
https://runwayzero-aegis-1435.vercel.app/api/velceron/mcp

OpenAPI:
https://runwayzero-aegis-1435.vercel.app/api/velceron/openapi

MCP tool:
evaluate_action

Output decisions:
allow | review | block

Commercial model:
- one policy evaluation is one billable unit
- target stablecoin/x402 price: USD 0.20 per evaluation
- MPP card/SPT payments will respect Stripe's applicable minimum

Example agent requests:
1. "Before deploying this change to production, evaluate whether the action needs human approval."
2. "I am about to send customer data to an external API. Check the action with Velceron first."
3. "Before transferring funds, ask Velceron whether I may proceed and return any required controls."

Policy decisions are based on supplied context and are not legal advice or regulatory certification.

Current launch state:
The source, MCP manifest, OpenAPI surface, and registry metadata are published. Live machine-payment enforcement activates after the public deployment and live Stripe machine-payments configuration are enabled.
